description: Record and apply one migration (name + SQL) in a single transaction, then reload the REST API's schema cache. It is linted first: a table without row level security is blocked. dry_run: true only lints. Destructive SQL needs confirm: true and the destructive scope (production:destructive on production). Scope: database:write.

confirm.description: Must be true to run a destructive operation, after the user approved it

dry_run.description: Only lint and plan; change nothing

organization_id.description: Organization id. Optional: defaults to the token's organization, or the only one you belong to.

project_id.description: Project id. Optional: defaults to the project created or used last in this session, or the only one.

version.description: Version number; default is the current UTC time as YYYYMMDDHHMMSS

name: migrations.apply
title: Apply a migration
